title: Bee manifest
description: What a source contributes to Bee: Bee's own manifests (priv/contributions/*.json) and plugins (<plugin>/plugin.json). Modelled on a VS Code extension's package.json.

name.description: Unique id: lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

publisher.description: Who made it (shown on its details page).

repository.description: Its source: a URL, or {"url": …} as in package.json.

icon.description: An image in the plugin's folder (PNG, SVG…), for its details page.

server.description: Code that runs in Bee's BEAM: Elixir (.ex) and/or Erlang (.erl) files. One module implements the Bee.Plugin behaviour.

module.description: The Bee.Plugin module: an Elixir name ("WordCount") or an Erlang one ("bee_upcase").

sources.description: Files or directories (relative to the plugin) to compile.

styles.description: A stylesheet (relative to the plugin) the page loads while the plugin is: for its LiveViews.

browser.description: ES module (relative to the plugin) loaded in the browser. It exports activate(bee).

extension.description: Code of a VS Code extension, run by Bee's extension host (Node.js) with the vscode API: what its package.json calls main.

main.description: The extension's entry file, relative to the plugin.

id.description: The extension's VS Code id, publisher.name: what other extensions depend on.

dependencies.description: Ids (publisher.name) of the extensions its code needs (extensionDependencies): it runs when they are installed and their code runs, after theirs.

languageTooling.description: The code is a client of a language server, debugger, linter or formatter: Bee has no API for those, and doesn't run it unless the extension is named in the extensions.enabledCode setting.

activationEvents.description: When the plugin's code starts: "*", "onStartupFinished", "onLanguage:<id>", "onView:<id>", "onCommand:<id>", "workspaceContains:<glob>". Others are ignored. Running one of the plugin's commands, or showing one of its views, always starts it.

submenus.description: Menus shown as an item of another menu: a menu item names one with "submenu", and its own items are contributed under its id in "menus".

menus.description: Menu id to items: "menubar/<id>", "editor/title" (editor buttons), "view/title" (view header buttons; `when` can test `view`), "view/item/context" (group "inline": buttons on a view's items; `when` can test `view` and `viewItem`), "commandPalette" (`when` false hides a command from the palette), "editor/title/context" (an editor tab's right-click menu: commands get the file's absolute path; `when` can test `resourcePath`, `resourceFilename`, `resourceExtname`), "explorer/context" (the Explorer's right-click menu: commands get the file's or folder's absolute path; `when` can test `explorerResourceIsFolder`, `explorerResourceIsRoot`, `resourcePath`, `resourceFilename`, `resourceExtname`), "editor/context" (the editor's right-click menu: commands get the file's absolute path). Context menus are grouped like VS Code's ("navigation", "5_cutcopypaste", "7_modification"…), with separators between groups.

jsonValidation.description: JSON Schemas for JSON files, like VS Code's (plugins only): fileMatch globs (a / matches the end of the path, ! excludes) and a schema file in the plugin or an http(s) address.

snippets.description: Snippet files like VS Code's (plugins only): for a language, or – without one – for the languages each snippet's scope lists, else all.

configuration.description: Settings: one section, or a list of them.

configurationDefaults.description: Other default values for settings (Bee's or other plugins'), like VS Code's. Language blocks ("[python]": {…}) are not applied yet.

activitybar.description: Icons in the activity bar; their views show in the sidebar.

panel.description: Sections of the bottom panel (its tabs: Terminal, Bee Console…); their views show in it.

views.description: Views container id (yours, or e.g. "explorer") to the views shown in it.

editors.description: Editors the plugin draws itself, each a LiveView (Bee.Plugin.LiveView) shown in an editor tab: opened with Bee.API.open_editor/3.

title.description: The tab's name (unless open_editor/3 gives one).

liveModule.description: A LiveView of the plugin (`use Bee.Plugin.LiveView`), by its module name, e.g. "Todos.ListLive": one of its server sources.

icon.description: Icon shown where the command is a button (editor/title, view/title, view/item/context menus): a Heroicons outline name ("arrow-path"), a codicon as in VS Code ("$(refresh)"), or images in the plugin for light and dark themes.

runtime.description: server: a handler in the BEAM (`@command` function of Bee or of the plugin's server module); client: a handler registered in the browser; extension: registered by the code of a VS Code extension (the plugin's "extension" part).

keybinding.description: Keys for a command, like VS Code's: "key" everywhere, unless "mac", "linux" or "win" names other keys for that platform (the browser's). Without "key", only on the platforms named.

args.description: What the command gets: a list is its arguments, anything else its one argument.

submenu.description: Instead of a command: the id of a submenu ("submenus") to open from this item, in context menus.

group.description: "<group>@<order>". Groups sort by name and are separated by a line; items sort by order.

viewsContainer.description: An icon in the activity bar, or a section of the bottom panel, that shows a set of views.

view.description: A view in a sidebar container or a panel section. A plugin fills its views with Bee.API.set_view/3, or draws one itself with a LiveView (live).

iconTheme.description: A file icon theme, in VS Code's format; picked with the workbench.iconTheme setting.

path.description: The theme's JSON file, relative to the plugin's folder.

colorTheme.description: A color theme, in VS Code's format; picked with the workbench.colorTheme setting (by id, or by label when there is no id).

uiTheme.description: Light (vs, hc-light) or dark (vs-dark, hc-black): the defaults for the colors the theme leaves out.

path.description: The theme's JSON file, relative to the plugin's folder. Without one: Bee's own light or dark theme.

language.description: A language, or more files for an existing one (contributions with the same id merge).

aliases.description: Display names; the first one is shown in the status bar.

filenamePatterns.description: Globs matched against the file name, or the workspace-relative path when they contain a slash.

firstLine.description: Regex matched against the first line.

configuration.description: A language-configuration.json like VS Code's, relative to the plugin: comments, brackets, auto-closing pairs, indentation, onEnter rules, folding (plugins only).

grammar.description: Highlighting for a language: the name of a CodeMirror mode registered in the browser (bundled with Bee, or registerMode() of a browser plugin), or a TextMate grammar file like VS Code's (plugins only).

language.description: The language it highlights; none for a grammar only included by others or injected.

path.description: The grammar file (.json, .tmLanguage.json, .tmLanguage, .plist), relative to the plugin.

embeddedLanguages.description: Scope → language id of the languages embedded in it.

injectTo.description: Scopes of the grammars it is injected into.

configuration.description: Settings: each property is a JSON Schema (draft 7) for one setting, with a default and a description.
